scope: Broaden current peer/source review, audit R2018 multiline ATTRIB/ATTDEF fields against ODA and local DWG codecs, and refine existing implementation readiness without promoting support.

method.kind: Local authoritative ODA PDF inspection, local source audit, current peer issue/release/source review
method.evidenceBoundary: ODA v5.4.1 §§20.4.4–20.4.5 define the documented ATTRIB/ATTDEF field order. Peer issues, manuals, release notes and source trees guide test selection but do not establish local runtime behavior or feature parity. The local audit establishes absent modeled/read/write fields, not production prevalence or native acceptance.

evidence.topic: R2018 multiline ATTRIB/ATTDEF outer annotative-data fields
evidence.observed: ODA v5.4.1 describes an R2010+ version RC, R2018+ attribute-type RC, and for multiline attributes an outer annotative-data BS size, conditional bytes, registered-application hard pointer and zero-valued BS before tag/flags/lock. This block is distinct from the embedded MTEXT object's own annotation state.
doesNotEstablish: that every multiline attribute has nonzero annotation data
which bytes or registered-application handle are present in arbitrary producer drawings
local runtime failure or native consumer acceptance
evidence.planUse: Add PAR-125 under existing 7M as 7M.2. Use generated AC1032 ATTRIB type-2 and ATTDEF type-4 controls for zero and nonzero sizes, exact bit positions, handle closure, and a following-record sentinel.

evidence.topic: Local ATTRIB/ATTDEF codec and data-model audit
evidence.observed: The local readers process R2010/R2018 attribute versions, nested MTEXT, tag, field length, flags, lock bit and style handle. The public DRW_Attrib model has no separate outer annotation-byte or application-handle carrier, and the inspected ATTRIB/ATTDEF DWG codecs do not consume or emit the outer ODA-described conditional block.
doesNotEstablish: that all existing AC1032 attributes fail or that any particular production file uses this branch
compatibility of a proposed public field/API until source-compatibility checks run
that writer/reader self-round-trip alone would prove wire correctness
evidence.planUse: Add an explicit typed or exactly retained model carrier with complete copy/move/reset behavior; preserve common single-line and 2D callback paths; resolve/remap the application reference safely or refuse before publication.

evidence.observed: The open peer report describes an AC1032 ATTRIB/ATTDEF contrast and claims the peer reads an additional R2010+ byte for ATTRIB, losing style-handle decoding in later versions. A WIP commit is linked, but no independent retest or released fix is established by the reviewed report.
doesNotEstablish: a correct local field-count change without the local ODA-based trace
evidence.planUse: Use as a version-boundary test lead for paired ATTRIB/ATTDEF style-handle assertions; keep it separate from the local outer-annotation finding.

evidence.observed: An older LibreDWG manual lists candidate PERSUBENTMGR counters and arrays. Current 0.14.1 release notes demote the type to Debugging; open issue #1398 reports an implausibly large num_subents under a proposed ordering and leaves the field sequence unresolved.
doesNotEstablish: an authoritative DWG layout or stable semantic model for PERSUBENTMGR
safe raw replay when references are unresolved or relocated
evidence.planUse: Keep the type in PAR-06's unsupported/debugging inventory. Do not parse from the older peer manual alone; use bounded opaque retention only where reference closure is known, otherwise report or refuse.

evidence.topic: Peer scale risks and ACadSharp release freshness
evidence.observed: LibreDWG #1395 reports quadratic growth of block-owned handle arrays in that peer's public DWG add API. ACadSharp v3.7.16 lists indexing inserts by block and other writer changes; v3.8.0 at signed commit 3a1c66b (2026-09-21) lists assembly visibility only.
doesNotEstablish: a performance or complexity defect in libdxfrw
that ACadSharp v3.8.0 adds broad semantic or ACIS writer support
evidence.planUse: Keep complexity checks tied to source-confirmed local hot paths and one composed scale smoke; avoid timing gates/full-scale runs in every slice. Use v3.8.0 as an optional reader/structural comparator, not proof of unrelated writer capability.

implementationReadiness.existingTopLevelOwner: 7M — Canonical embedded attributes and explicit downgrade outcomes
implementationReadiness.newFinding: PAR-125 — R2018 multiline ATTRIB/ATTDEF outer annotation fields are not represented or handled by the local DWG codecs
generatedControls: AC1032 ATTRIB type 2 and ATTDEF type 4 with zero and distinctive nonzero outer annotation sizes
application-handle resolution/remapping and distinct style-handle checks
truncated/invalid size and unresolved application negative cases
implementationReadiness.compatibility: Preserve single-line and established 2D callback behavior; do not add a pure virtual callback. Any public model fields need copy/move/reset semantics and target/LibreCAD_3 compile checks.
implementationReadiness.validationBudget: Touched strict build, focused generated attribute target, lc3_compat_check when API/data layout changes, and git diff --check; defer full suites and native/peer execution to composed checkpoints.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No external drawing was downloaded or committed. Generate controls from scratch and use temporary outputs; any future producer/native witness stays at one composed gate.
